steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and sign in with username admin and password admin (if prompted to change the password, skip it). Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the dashboard search). Once it is open, report the exact titles of all panels shown on that dashboard, exactly as they appear on the page.

In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard (Dashboards -> New dashboard -> Add visualization, or the + Create -> Dashboard button). Add a Stat panel and set its title to exactly '{{runid}} Availability'. For the panel's query, select the 'TestData' data source (also called 'TestData DB' / testdata) so the panel gets data. Then save the dashboard with the title '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (Save dashboard dialog, folder General is fine, do not tick anything about overwriting). After saving, report the browser's current page URL and confirm the panel title shown on the dashboard.

steps.instruction: On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}): open Dashboard settings (gear icon) -> General, and add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's tags (type 'bench' in the tags field and press Enter so it becomes a chip). Then, in the same settings page, set the dashboard's default time range to the last 6 hours if such a control exists there. Save the settings. Then open the top-bar time picker and set the range to 'Last 6 hours' and apply it. Then save the dashboard (Ctrl+S / Save dashboard) and in the Save dashboard dialog TICK the 'Update default time range' checkbox before clicking Save. Report what the save dialog showed and whether the save succeeded.
